messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — legal flagged export controls in Aurora Labs' open-weight license. We need to decide marketplace availability and the exact wording we show to customers. Putting this in #partnerships so we don't miss regional restrictions.

Liam O'Connor: Thanks Maya. What's the exact problem/phrase? can we host in EU/UK and APAC? :thinking_face: 

Claire (Legal): Quick summary: license permits redistribution but disallows "use in or transfer to sanctioned jurisdictions" and requires attribution + forbids military use. Key excerpt below:

``
"Recipient shall not export, re-export, transfer, or otherwise make available the Software to any country or entity subject to embargo or sanctions by the U.S., EU, or UK. Commercial redistribution in hardware bundles requires explicit written permission from Aurora Labs."
``

Claire (Legal): So two pieces: (A) geo/re-export restrictions (embargoed jurisdictions), (B) redistribution-in-bundles needs separate permission.

Sophie Patel: So we need to do geo-blocking on listings + show a visible "export-restricted" badge. Also add "redistribution requires partner permission" note on the SKU page.

Rajesh Singh: Technical feasibility: we can set per-SKU allowed_regions and a small UI flag. Options:
1) Global listing with embargoed regions blocked (automated via sanction lists)
2) Region-limited listing (e.g., EU only)
3) Controlled partner distribution (requires our ops/legal approval per partner)

Rajesh Singh: Option 1 has the best customer experience but requires maintaining sanction lists and ensuring downstream SI bundles are handled by legal.

Maya Chen: I prefer option 1 if Legal signs off. Also need to clarify "commercial use" vs "internal use" for customers — partner wants to re-sell in hardware bundles.

Claire (Legal): We should surface two short clauses in the marketplace metadata and an FAQ: "Allowed uses" and "Prohibited uses". Proposed short license blurb for UI:

"This model is subject to export controls. Use and redistribution are prohibited in sanctioned jurisdictions (per OFAC, EU and UK consolidated lists). Redistribution in hardware or bundled products requires express written permission from the model provider and Redwood." 

Liam O'Connor: Can we show a tooltip with a one-line summary and a link to the full license text + our FAQ? Also a visual badge on the SKU listing would be helpful.

Sophie Patel: Yes — marketplace-bot can add tags. Proposed tags: export_restricted, attribution_required, no_military_use.

marketplace-bot: note: SKU 4587 currently global=true, regions=[] -> will queue update when tags and geo rules confirmed.

Rajesh Singh: Action items I propose:
- Claire: draft the legal blurb + one-page redistribution addendum for SI/hardware partners (due EOD)
- Sophie: add UI badge mock + tag support and small FAQ page (due tomorrow noon)
- Rajesh: implement per-SKU geo-block and link to sanction feeds (staging rollout Wed)
- Maya: coordinate partner comms and confirm upstream permission for redistribution after Claire's draft

Claire (Legal): Confirmed: source sanction lists = OFAC + EU consolidated + UK sanctions list. I'll include sample clause and a short FAQ Q/A covering "what counts as redistribution" vs "internal use".

Maya Chen: Important follow-up: Aurora Labs asked whether we can handle redistribution for their SI partners under a separate addendum. Claire, do we need a signed reseller addendum per partner?

Claire (Legal): Yes — for redistribution in hardware bundles we need a signed addendum that: (a) grants redistribution rights for the specific SKU(s), (b) requires attribution and compliance obligations, (c) includes indemnities for export control violations. I'll produce a one-page template.

Liam O'Connor: Timeline check?

Claire (Legal): Draft by EOD today, final sign-off by Friday.

Sophie Patel: UI mock by tomorrow 12:00. I'll include badge variants and a modal with the license snippet + link to full text.

Rajesh Singh: I'll sync with eng-sre on sanction list ingestion, schedule staging rollout Wednesday morning.

Maya Chen: Great. I'll hold off partner outreach until Claire shares the draft. Thanks all — I'll follow up after EOD. :rocket: 

Sophie Patel: tagging @marketplace-bot in draft channel when mock done.

marketplace-bot: reminder created -> PR template: marketplace/export-restrictions-update.automation

Maya Chen: Closing note: also confirm telemetry — we should log partner downloads and redistribution requests for audit. Raj, can you add an event (model.redistribution.requested) to the schema?

Rajesh Singh: yep will add event, include partner_id, sku_id, request_time, approval_status.

Claire (Legal): I'll include recordkeeping requirements in the addendum.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if Aurora pushes changes.
